violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. (CORRECTED) CFM arrived during the inspection.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Other Chemical Proper Use
violations.observation: The operator is using a sanitizer, LACTIC ACID and is not using the product in accordance with manufacturer's guidelines. When tested, the con concentration was not within the acceptable range.
violations.corrective_action: If a chemical sanitizer other than chlorine, iodine, or quaternary ammonium compound is used it shall be applied in accordance with the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Adjust the concentration accordingly.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: beef pot roast=45-47F at walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. (CORRECTED)Item was discarded during the inspection.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, ion the cook-line, in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: liquid food items such as oils, etc, and sauced in squeeze bottles.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Observed em,played wearing a watch wheel preparing food on the Cookline.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. IHOP #471 (Inspection Date: 03/26/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored in Packaging
violations.observation: Exposed coffee filters were observed stored unprotected at the coffee station of The Wait station.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items shall be stored in a clean, dry location that is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. In addition, the single-service items shall be kept in the original protective package or stored by using other means that afford protection from contamination until used.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: 3 Compartment Sink Required
violations.observation: There is no 3-compartment sink available drop use , during the inspection, in the establishment. The existing 3-compartment sink had been removed an d a new unit was being installed. The existing grease trap was removed and replaced with a new unit.
violations.corrective_action: A sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and sanitizing equipment and utensils. Our officer was not notified. Obtain approval and inspection for these equipment and plumbing done, by the regulating office.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: Food supplies stored in a located where they were exposed to ice crystals , inside the walk-in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. Remove all food supplies away from this area to prevent them from being contaminated by the ice crystals.

violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Repair or replace the broken cover on this equipment.
